well_authored.name: Sales Playbook: Discovery Call Framework
well_authored.description: Step-by-step framework for conducting B2B discovery calls. Use when preparing for or debriefing after initial prospect meetings. Covers qualification criteria, key questions by persona, red flags, and next-step recommendations.

well_authored.name: Brand Voice Guidelines: External Communications
well_authored.description: Defines tone, style, and messaging standards for all customer-facing content including emails, proposals, and marketing collateral. Use when writing any communication that represents the company to prospects or customers.

well_authored.name: Data Handling and Privacy Policy: Customer Data
well_authored.description: Governs how customer data is collected, stored, processed, and deleted. Reference when handling PII, responding to GDPR/CCPA requests, conducting security reviews, or designing data pipelines. Includes DPA requirements and consent frameworks.

well_authored.name: Product Knowledge: Core Analytics Platform
well_authored.description: Technical and functional overview of the core analytics platform. Use when answering prospect questions about features, architecture, integrations, performance, and roadmap. Includes competitive differentiators and positioning against alternatives.

well_authored.name: Support Escalation Policy: Incident Response
well_authored.description: Defines escalation paths, response time SLAs, and communication templates for P1-P4 customer incidents. Use when a customer reports an issue or when triaging incoming support tickets. Covers severity classification criteria and stakeholder notification rules.
